question:
How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: How old the patient refers to SUBTRACT(year(`Examination Date`), year(Birthday)); the highest hemoglobin count refers to MAX(HGB)

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(e.XCL_002, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(p.XCL_060, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    e.XCL_008 AS diagnosis
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
JOIN Examination e ON e.XCL_001 = p.XCL_058 AND e.XCL_002 = l.XCL_015
ORDER BY l.XCL_032 DESC
LIMIT 1;
